principle: Measure football interactions first; only a separately validated family may change the serving mean.

team_volume_to_player_share.scope: team plays and pass/rush volume interacted with player target/carry share

opponent_pressure_and_efficiency.scope: pressure, sacks, success rate, explosive plays, red-zone profile by scheduled opponent

offensive_line_vs_front.scope: pass-protection and run-block proxies interacted with opponent pressure/run-front profiles

play_caller_and_offensive_tendencies.scope: pace, pass rate, concentration, committee, TE usage, QB run, play action, motion, red-zone tendencies

qb_passing_rushing_components.scope: separate passing and rushing context components before recombination

te_system_role.scope: TE usage, target concentration, team passing environment, route/snap opportunity where available

camp_role_state.scope: training-camp/news evidence changes role uncertainty, never the serving mean directly

qb_target_ecosystem.scope: primary QB plus team target/snap pecking order

direct_qb_to_receiver_pair_effect.scope: relationship retained; no pair-specific mean coefficient yet

kicker_projection_market_weather.scope: baseline projection, ADP, replacement value, environment and draft timing

dst_projection_market_environment.scope: baseline projection, ADP, replacement value, game environment and draft timing

decision_schedule_horizon.scope: Start/Sit=current week; Waivers=audited multi-week horizon; League Impact=remaining real schedule; Draft=season value/market timing

fourth_down_aggressiveness.scope: 2023-2025 team and head-coach go/FG/punt rates on tracked kickable fourth-down decisions

kicker_distance_distribution.scope: 2023-2025 attempts and makes by distance bucket, including 50-59 and 60+

kickable_drive_and_red_zone_stall_rate.scope: 2023-2025 drive-level opponent-40 and red-zone field-goal/TD outcome rates

dst_pressure_sack_takeaway_interactions.scope: 2023-2025 defense sacks/QB hits/takeaways paired with opponent offense sacks/turnovers allowed
